invariants.rule: Commit requires atomic boundary and durable readback
Unknown/stale CURRENT cannot clear native menu or authorize save
Interrupted commits retain old state or explicit committed evidence
Independent auth survives CURRENT failure without provisioning
invariants.testId: auth/capabilities remain canonical and independent of unreadable CURRENT, setup and native work

invariants.rule: Recovery is bound to validated evidence, never native inference
Unavailable evidence and unknown original cause stay visible
Inspection cannot impersonate authority or leak private support data
Confirmed reconstruction is not original-state restoration
Discovery health trace and support do not mutate durable state

invariants.testId: Boolean receipt, mismatched destination/bytes and unavailable final readback cannot count as saved
